title: Sources: the CIA and the ODNI recently discovered a cybersecurity breach affecting an open-source intelligence analysis system, exposing some unclassified info (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Sources: the CIA and the ODNI recently discovered a cybersecurity breach affecting an open-source intelligence analysis system, exposing some unclassified info — The intrusion affecting the C.I.A. and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence comes amid heightened concerns about cybersecurity.
